08-02-1483 is February 8, 1483.  
49 weeks + 7 days = 49*7 + 7 = 343 + 7 = 350 days.  
Add 350 days to 1483-02-08:  
1483 is not a leap year (1483 not divisible by 4), so Feb has 28 days.  
From Feb 8: 28 - 8 = 20 days left in Feb → 20 days used, 330 days left.  
March (31), April (30), May (31), June (30), July (31), August (31), September (30), October (31), November (30), December (31) → sum these sequentially until 330 runs out.  
20 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 20 + 306 = 326 days used by end of November, 330 - 326 = 4 days into December.  
So December 4, 1483.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1483-12-04
